name: Gemma 3 27B (multimodal)
notes: PARAMS: 27.43B is the safetensors count (27B nominal) and INCLUDES the vision tower; the text-only figure Google quotes is smaller. Do not compare this 27.43B against a text-only dense model without noting the multimodal headroom. KV: 62 * 16 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 507,904 bytes/token = 496 KiB/token, the largest per-token KV in this set. The reason is the 5:1 local/global ratio (sliding_window_pattern=6) meaning nearly two-thirds of layers are global-attention layers that must keep the full 128k. The 1024-token sliding window is short enough that the effective saving is real but bounded: at 128k context, 52 of 62 layers keep ~1024 tokens and 10 layers keep all 128k, so effective KV is roughly 10/62 of the naive number, about 80 MiB per 128k sequence rather than 62 GiB. A serving engine that does not implement the 5:1 pattern pays the full 496 KiB/token. VISION: SigLIP encoder, 27 layers, hidden 1152, FROZEN during training and shared identically across the 4B/12B/27B sizes (per Google's developer guide). High-resolution and non-square images are handled by adaptive windowing rather than fixed 896x896 tiles. The ViT runs once per image at prefill and its cost does not grow with decode, so it shifts the FLOP mix toward prefill exactly as expected for a VLM. final_logit_softcapping and attn_logit_softcapping are both null in Gemma 3: the softcapping from Gemma 2 was removed.
